coder_notes: High-grade glioma only, glioblastoma never named, so screening fails at S5. Anaesthetic techniques are registered as Other, with no named drugs; listed as supportive rows for transparency. The trial tests an effect of anaesthetic type on survival (antitumour-type outcome) but no drug is identifiable, so no candidate. Treatment setting inferred from exclusion of recurrent disease and first-time surgery (coded newly_diagnosed). Both arms are OTHER type and are comparisons of each other, so control_arm_from_other_arms coded yes (one technique acts as the reference).
